'''Zutton''' was a [[Snivvian]] [[Gender|male]] who was an [[artist]], as well as a highly-skilled [[bounty hunter]] for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[1 BBY]], where he was nicknamed "Snaggletooth." He and his brother [[Takeel]] were present when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in the [[cantina]] and were still in the building when the pair had a confrontation with the thugs [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]]. Later, he spoke with the [[Nimbanel]] [[Mosep Binneed]] in the streets of [[Mos Eisley]]. In [[35 ABY]], he attended [[Pasaana]]'s [[Festival of the Ancestors]].

==Biography==
The [[Snivvian]] [[Gender|male]] Zutton was an [[artist]] who frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> with his brother [[Takeel]]. Like most Snivvians, the pair were often referred to as snaggletooths.<ref name="Alien Archive" /> "Snaggletooth" was considered his nickname in the cantina. Zutton was also considered to be an exceptionally-skilled [[bounty hunter]], and these skills had caught the attention of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who kept his services on retainer.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]</ref>

When the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and his [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] entered the [[cantina]]<ref name="ANH" /> in [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1|Zutton's appearance}}</ref> Zutton was stood with his back to the door talking to a [[human]]<ref name="ANH" /> in front of the booth where [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] were playing on stage.<ref name="Complete Locations" />Zutton then moved to the front of the bar, and turned to look at Skywalker when the bartender [[Wuher]] informed the moisture farmer that his droids were not welcome in the establishment.<ref name="ANH" /> The Snivvian then moved further down the bar, and was on the opposite side when the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] stepped in to defend Skywalker from the thugs [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]].<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Zutton later left the cantina, and was stood in the street talking to<ref name="ANH" /> the [[Nimbanel]] [[Mosep Binneed]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> when Kenobi, Skywalker, and his two droids passed the pair on their way to [[Docking Bay 94]].<ref name="ANH" />

Zutton later attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on [[Pasaana]],<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Zutton had light skin, [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]]. He had a hunchback, resulting in his right shoulder being notably higher than his left.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While in Mos Eisley, Zutton wore a [[Color|red]] tunic over a black shirt along with light-colored pants and [[boot]]s.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Snaggletooth" dates back to the original [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|toy line]], in which an action figure based on the Snivvian was given the name.<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (toy line)|pack=Snaggletooth|link=VINtSnaggletooth.asp}}</ref> Later sources which are now identified as belonging to the [[Canon|''Star Wars'' Legends]] timeline noted that the name Snaggletooth was actually a nickname, and that the [[Gender|male]] Snivvian's real name was Zutton. The "Zutton" name was later canonized with the release of the canon guide book ''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''.<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Meanwhile, the first canon source to provide the name Snaggletooth was the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' mobile app.<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 4|cardname=Snaggletooth}}</ref> The character is otherwise unnamed in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" />

Although the character in the film wears a red-colored shirt, the original Kenner toy featured blue clothing. The figure's clothing was changed to red during the toy line's production run, as was the figure's height. Snaggletooth's general appearance later served as inspiration for [[Katt Mol]], a Snivvian character who appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television episode]] "[[Padawan Lost]]."<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/padawan-lost-episode-guide|text="Padawan Lost" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref>
